description: Create src/todo_db/mcp/ with a FastMCP stdio server: todo-db[mcp] optional dependency, todo-db-mcp entry point that fails with an install hint when mcp is absent, target resolution (--config/--db/--repo-root then TODO_DB_* then upward discovery, pinned for process life), a startup READ_ONLY open that runs schema and identity checks only, a mandatory explicit-actor resolution that never calls default_actor() (--actor/TODO_DB_ACTOR or an initialize-derived mcp:<client>:<user>@<host>), a per-process session UUID passed on take, one dedicated worker thread that owns all database and git work, and todo://instructions plus a get_instructions tool and an additive todo/workflow prompt.

preserves.behavior: The floor CLI gains no new runtime dependency; mcp stays an optional extra
The server never derives a stable principal from a session id (ADR 0003 2.1/2.2)
stdio stdout carries only JSON-RPC framing

work_units.evidence: SDK mcp 1.29.1 under >=1.10.0,<2; Python >=3.10 floor unchanged (both majors support 3.10+), no requires-python move
work_units.summary: Confirm the MCP Python SDK version, its Python floor, and whether requires-python or the CI matrix must move

work_units.evidence: mcp optional dep in pyproject.toml, todo-db-mcp entry point added, contracts updated
work_units.summary: Add src/todo_db/mcp/ package skeleton, pyproject optional-dependency and entry point

work_units.evidence: target resolution with flag>env>discovery, startup READ_ONLY no-migrate check via run_in_worker_sync in main (commit d38ac42)
work_units.summary: Implement target resolution and the READ_ONLY schema-check lifespan

work_units.evidence: mandatory actor resolution via PrincipalHolder, clientInfo-derived mcp:<name>:<user>@<host> with sanitize, no default_actor
work_units.summary: Implement mandatory actor resolution and per-process session id

work_units.evidence: single dedicated worker thread (ThreadPoolExecutor max_workers=1) owns all DB/git, run_in_worker and run_in_worker_sync
work_units.summary: Implement the single dedicated worker thread for all DB and git work

work_units.evidence: todo://instructions resource, get_instructions tool, todo/workflow prompt with MCP-shaped guidance
work_units.summary: Add the instructions resource, get_instructions tool, and the todo/workflow prompt

work_units.evidence: --log-level flag with structured stderr logging, todo-db mcp alias, FastMCP lifespan without log_level arg
work_units.summary: Add a --log-level flag with structured stderr logging and the todo-db mcp CLI alias
